description: This PHP source file defines a class `UriComparator` which provides methods to determine if a modified URL is considered cross-origin relative to an original URL, based on host, scheme, and port comparisons.

classes.name: UriComparator
classes.description: Provides static methods to compare URIs for cross-origin considerations.

methods.name: isCrossOrigin
methods.description: Determines if a modified URI should be considered cross-origin with respect to the original URI.

methods.name: computePort
methods.description: Computes the port for a given URI, defaulting to 443 for HTTPS or 80 for HTTP if not explicitly specified.
